transcript.text: Have you ever stayed so focused on one
direction that you later realized you
missed a better opportunity?
>> Yes, but I think that's part of the
path. Learning about the next or better
opportunity only comes as a result of
pursuing one and then starting to map
the terrain. So, it's like walking
through the forest and then getting to
the other side and seeing a hill and
then seeing another path once you walk
through or walk up the hill. It's like,
"Yeah, but you had to get there to get
the vantage point." So, maybe your
second time you go faster and that's
just how it works cuz I think all it is
is just a wishing for omniscience, which
is that we just know everything. If you
could start day one with ultimate cheat
codes of max money, max health, max
everything, you would literally ruin the
game to begin with and you wouldn't want
to play.
